scope: Single candidate profile, all-chapter orientation, exact-grant internal draft creation, compact governance metadata and plain ES/EN language only.

critic_findings.finding: The initial proxy generated a fresh idempotency key per POST, allowing a browser retry to become a second create operation.
critic_findings.repair: Generate one UUID key in the rendered form, validate it in the proxy, reuse it in the backend call and derive the stable slug suffix from it.

critic_findings.finding: An identity with exact create authority but no visible campaigns could not reach campaign creation.
critic_findings.repair: Render the governed first-draft form for authorized empty tenants while preserving the fail-closed empty state for all others.

critic_findings.finding: The first single-view composition still placed action guidance before the candidate profile.
critic_findings.repair: Render profile and risks first, then the next-step brief and evidence disclosure.

critic_findings.finding: Campaign selection, empty state and creation competed inside an ambiguous two-column composition.
critic_findings.repair: Use one stacked action column and group every creation label with its field.

critic_findings.finding: Browser reviewers still encoded the retired three-tab candidate interaction.
critic_findings.repair: Validate the visible profile, all-chapter orientation and keyboard-operable evidence disclosure instead.

critic_findings.finding: An 8-hex slug suffix provided less collision margin than the backend length contract permits.
critic_findings.repair: Use a deterministic 12-hex suffix while keeping the total slug below 100 characters.

critic_findings.finding: Nested Docker failed before product startup while registering the PostgreSQL 18 image layer with lchown /var/empty: permission denied.
critic_findings.repair: Require hosted exact-head PostgreSQL 18/API/browser verification before merge.

critic_findings.finding: The hosted PostgreSQL/browser fixture did not include campaign-create authority, so the new draft flow would not execute in CI.
critic_findings.repair: Keep the default 11-grant operator unchanged and add one opt-in E2E-only exact tenant grant plus DRAFT, context and access assertions.

critic_findings.finding: The English functional journey still selected the retired Sources and evidence tab.
critic_findings.repair: Assert Profile and risks, Next step and zero tabs, then open the evidence disclosure directly.

critic_findings.finding: Hosted run 30678840392 reached PostgreSQL 18 and the API-backed journey but timed out on a second Spanish selector for the retired Fuentes y evidencia tab after chapter navigation.
critic_findings.repair: Open .candidate-evidence-disclosure after chapter navigation and add static regression tests forbidding every retired candidate-tab selector in both browser reviewers.

hosted_ci.failed_step: Exercise the API-backed functional onboarding journey
